metric_expectations.source_text: Out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs.
DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count.
Max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold.
Parameter sensitivity: +/-25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline.

metric_expectations.notes: Preserved from D2-006 but not compared because OL-0030.metrics.gross_pnl <= 0, so the cost_drag_fraction as a fraction of gross PnL is not semantically interpretable as a pass/fail ratio.

metric_expectations.source_text: No single 90-day window contributes > 60% of total PnL.

Preserved from D2-006 but not compared because REC v1 realized_metrics copy OL metrics and OL-0030 does not include free_parameter_count.

realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12do / WP-S2c-78 uses the final local data-year evaluation window, 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11, as H-004 selected pre-WP-5b combined R1+R2 cycle 1 after the original full-period no-formal-split retrospective baseline. Indicators are warmed up on prior available 1d history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-004 REP-0005 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this report records explicit non-cloned bounded-window disclosure for additional pre-WP-5b runway evidence.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: D2-006 requires out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0030 records sharpe below that threshold.
D2-006 uses strict gt semantics for DSR > 1.0; OL-0030 records dsr below that threshold.
D2-006 requires max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold; OL-0030 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
D2-006 requires parameter sensitivity min_ratio >= 0.70; OL-0030 records sensitivity_min_ratio below that threshold.
D2-006 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0030 records walk_forward_efficiency above that threshold.

interpretation: REC-0047 derives from OL-0030 and is the WP-S2c-78 H-004 selected pre-WP-5b d2_006_gates cycle 1 REC under approved combined R1+R2 methodology. It is the second REC observation for the exact segment H-004 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / d2_006_gates, increasing the exact segment count from 1 to 2 if validation confirms. It does not satisfy REC-5 and does not floor-cross the segment. Cost-drag is preserved but not deterministically compared because OL-0030.metrics.gross_pnl <= 0 makes cost_drag_fraction semantically uninterpretable as a pass/fail ratio. OL-0030 is reused by REC-0048 for the separate exp_success_criteria exact segment under R1 paired-source reuse; separate REC artifacts and separate expectation-source comparisons preserve exact-segment separation. H-004 post-WP-5b exact segments remain untouched and outside the selected A2C-002 runway package. REC-0047 does not create H-004 completion, selected pre-WP-5b REC-5 floor crossing, A2C-002 completion, Path B, policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper-live/runtime, lifecycle, promotion, demotion, protected-path authority, or downstream authority.
